description: Open a Final Cut Pro XML file as a new Premiere project. app.openFCPXML(path, projPath) requires a destination project path; it does not merge the XML into the currently open project. verified is true only when that destination exists as a file and Premiere has that exact path open.

path.description: Full path to the FCP XML file to read

project_path.description: Full path of the new .prproj file Premiere should create for the imported timeline. Required: app.openFCPXML takes both a source and a destination path.

name: import_fcp_xml

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Import Fcp Xml
